financial_definitions.expected_revenue: saved purchase probability * saved conditional expected spending
financial_definitions.forecast_disagreement: Differences among saved forecast models; not causal and not revenue exposure.
financial_definitions.opportunity_proxy: (1 - purchase probability) * conditional expected spending; screening proxy only, not recoverable loss.
financial_definitions.reference_exposure: max(0, documented matched reference expected revenue - current expected revenue)
financial_definitions.reference_exposure_reason: No defensible, chronologically valid matched reference forecast exists in the saved data.
financial_definitions.scenario_contribution: assumed gross margin * hypothetical incremental revenue - campaign contact costs; only when margin is supplied
financial_definitions.scenario_incremental_probability: min(1 - current purchase probability, assumed response probability * assumed uplift if responded)
financial_definitions.scenario_incremental_revenue: scenario incremental probability * saved conditional expected spending

H1_financial_concentration.threshold: top 10% historical gross-spending share of at least 50%

H2_risk_value_interaction.evidence: Compared deterministic ranking overlaps; distinct selections alone do not imply better interventions.

H3_forecast_reliability_sensitivity.evidence: Uses the fixed TEST revenue diagnostics from Notebook 09 without correcting production forecasts.

H4_budget_sensitivity.evidence: Scenario grids vary contact cost and budget under explicit hypothetical response/uplift assumptions.

H5_scenario_robustness.evidence: Screening rankings do not depend on campaign response/uplift assumptions; this is by design, not causal robustness.

H6_predictive_ranking.evidence: 30- and 60-day ranking rules are selected on prospective validation outcomes and evaluated on the locked TEST against matched high-value baselines; 90-day selection is unavailable.

limitations: The dataset has no randomized retention treatment or response outcomes; no causal campaign uplift is estimated.
No defensible same-customer counterfactual business reference is available; reference-based revenue exposure is not estimable.
Historical-rate and segment-aware forecasts are alternative models, not causal counterfactuals.
The nonreturn-weighted spending proxy applies conditional spending in a hypothetical nonpurchase scenario.
The final 90-day model has no prospective validation vintage; 90-day ranking comparisons are exploratory and cannot select a policy.
The 30- and 60-day validation-selected ranking methods are evaluated once on the frozen historical TEST cohort.
Notebook 09 TEST calibration and revenue bias are historical group/portfolio diagnostics, not individual prediction intervals.
